//Oidc: Oidc:Authority = the IDP (same address in every component). Oidc:ClientId must equal ClientIds:CustomerOnboardingWeb in src/IDP/appsettings.json, where the IDP registers this BFF (redirect URIs from ClientBaseUrls:CustomerOnboardingWeb); the BFF proves itself with private_key_jwt: its private key file is Oidc:ClientKey (appsettings.Development.json), and its public key is ClientKeys:<this client ID> in the IDP's settings.
//ShellOrigin: The Shell (https): the only page that may frame this MFE, and where step-up ends. Must equal ClientBaseUrls:Shell in src/IDP/appsettings.json.
//ConnectionStrings: BffStateDbConnection holds a password, so it is NOT in this file (which goes into the container image): Development reads it from appsettings.Development.json, everywhere else from the environment (ConnectionStrings__BffStateDbConnection) or a secret store. Missing = the BFF refuses to start.
